$comment: The ten principal Upaniṣads, for the comparison table on /upanishads/. Hand-written facts of affiliation and structure; every 'famous' quotation is checked by check.py against a passage in upanishads/isha/edition/witnesses/parallels.json (Īśā quotations against its own text). 'level' is the edition's recommendation, explained on the page. 'edition' is set only when a study edition exists.

levels.beginner: Short, in verse or simple narrative; can be read with only this site's introduction.
levels.intermediate: Longer or more technical; assumes the basic vocabulary (Brahman, ātman, prāṇa, Om).
levels.advanced: Long prose with ritual background, or dense doctrine best read with a commentary.

upanishads.subject: The Lord in all things; action without attachment; knowledge and works; the dying person’s prayers

famous.en: All this is to be dwelt in by the Lord
The face of the real is covered by a golden vessel

upanishads.structure: 4 khaṇḍas: two in verse, two in prose
upanishads.subject: What moves the mind and the senses; the story of the gods and the Yakṣa

famous.quote: न तत्र चक्षुर्गच्छति न वाग्गच्छति नो मनः
famous.en: There the eye does not go, nor speech, nor the mind

upanishads.structure: 2 adhyāyas of 3 vallīs each, in verse
upanishads.subject: Naciketas and Yama: death, the good and the pleasant, the Self

famous.en: The good and the pleasant both come to a person

famous.quote: आत्मानं रथिनं विद्धि शरीरं रथमेव तु
famous.en: Know the self as the rider, the body as the chariot
Arise, awake; having reached the excellent ones, understand

upanishads.subject: Six students’ questions: the origin of beings, prāṇa, Om, the person of sixteen parts

famous.quote: एतद्वै सत्यकाम परं चापरं च ब्रह्म यदोङ्कारः
famous.en: Satyakāma, this syllable Om is the higher and the lower Brahman

upanishads.structure: 3 muṇḍakas of 2 khaṇḍas each, in verse
upanishads.subject: The higher and the lower knowledge; the two birds; the imperishable

famous.en: Two kinds of knowledge are to be known
Two birds, companions and friends
Truth alone conquers, not untruth

upanishads.subject: Om and the four states: waking, dream, deep sleep and the fourth

famous.quote: सर्वं ह्य् एतद् ब्रह्मायम् आत्मा ब्रह्म
famous.en: All this is Brahman; this self is Brahman

famous.quote: प्रपञ्चोपशमं शान्तं शिवम् अद्वैतं चतुर्थं मन्यन्ते
famous.en: The cessation of the world, peaceful, auspicious, non-dual: that they consider the fourth

upanishads.subject: Instruction of the student; the sheaths of the self; Brahman as bliss

famous.en: Brahman is truth, knowledge, the infinite
Speak the truth; practise dharma

upanishads.subject: Creation from the Self; the three births; consciousness as Brahman

famous.en: Consciousness is Brahman

upanishads.location: the last eight chapters of the Chāndogya Brāhmaṇa
upanishads.subject: The Udgītha and Om; Śāṇḍilya; Uddālaka and Śvetaketu; Sanatkumāra and Nārada; the space within the heart

famous.en: All this is Brahman
You are that, Śvetaketu

upanishads.location: the last book of the Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa (Kāṇva book 17)
upanishads.subject: Yājñavalkya’s debates; Maitreyī; the Self as ‘not this, not this’; the person at death

famous.en: ‘I am Brahman’
Not this, not this
From the unreal lead me to the real
